description: This file contains utility functions for handling mentions within a chat application, specifically for a Feishu bot integration. It includes functions to escape regex characters, extract mention targets from messages, determine whether a message is a mention forward request, and format mention strings for various message types.

methods.description: Escape regex metacharacters in a string to treat user-controlled mention fields literally.

methods.description: Extract mention targets from a Feishu message event, excluding mentions of the bot itself if specified.

methods.description: Determine if a message is a mention forward request based on chat type and mentions present.
